reference.reuse: Performance categories only; no textures, models, curves or expression values copied.

catalogue.origin: POPY-authored timings/curves. Anon used for performance categories only.
catalogue.playback: Play emote_* without a simultaneous fixed exp3 to retain facial animation.

actions.label: 失落低头
actions.limitation: No sad-brow or downturned-mouth runtime shape; lowered gaze and posture approximate sadness.

actions.label: 抽泣姿态（无泪水）
actions.limitation: Sobbing gesture only; no tears, wet eyes, sad-brow or facial shadow layers.

actions.label: 害羞躲闪
actions.limitation: No cheek/blush channel; avoidance, eyelids, smile and hands express shyness.

limitations: No tears/blush/hearts/sad-mouth or sad-brow controls; see per-action catalogue limitations.
Face metrics use the projected source-face bounding region, including any hair within it; no feature segmentation.
Head geometry includes hidden vertices and intentional previous repairs; it is not a visible-surface-only metric.
12fps WebP files are offline previews, not measured realtime playback; MOC cost remains high.
Independent finite pose validation only; no cloth/finger-contact solver or official Cubism Core/Editor validation.
